summary: Contestants demonstrate their understanding of spelling, grammar, and writing skills for business communication. The event consists of an objective test covering clarity, accuracy, and tone in professional communications. Any middle level student may enter, and the test lasts no more than sixty minutes.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
what_to_bring: Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
competencies: Analyze professional written communications for clarity and accuracy, applying correct grammar, spelling, and tone across digital and traditional formats
Effectively analyze the use of verbal, nonverbal, and electronic communication
Demonstrate the importance of maintaining positive relationships in work environments
Demonstrate the job application process using digital platforms, networking tools, and application strategies
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this objective event.
